about.label: About
about.title: We are building the future of technology today
about.text: PolyTech Park is a technology park at Satbayev University, where science meets industry. For over 90 years the university has developed engineering sciences in close connection with the real economy, and the technopark brings research into practice — from work in its own laboratories to deploying solutions in the construction and industrial sectors.
about.pageText: PolyTechPark JSC is a subsidiary of Satbayev University, established to commercialize scientific developments and carry out R&D for industry.
overview: PolyTechPark JSC operates within Satbayev University and connects the university's research teams with the real economy. We take a development from the level of laboratory research and bring it to a solution that works in production.

Our core focus is construction technology: formulations and materials, testing, and the optimization of production processes. Research is carried out in our own laboratories for the specific needs of industrial partners.

The technopark supports a project at every stage: defining the task and R&D, laboratory testing and prototypes, preparing technical documentation, transferring the technology to the client and supporting its rollout.

history.title: About PolyTechPark
body: PolyTechPark JSC is a subsidiary of Satbayev University, established to commercialize scientific developments and carry out R&D for industry.

The technopark connects the university's research teams with the real economy: it takes a development from the level of laboratory research and brings it to a solution that works in production. Its core focus is construction technology.
Work is carried out as a full cycle — from defining the task and R&D to laboratory testing, prototypes, technical documentation and transferring the technology to the client.
